cards.front: Recall a key point about Rock Deformation & Stress
cards.back: Stress is the force applied to rock; strain is the resulting deformation

cards.front: Recall a key point about Rock Deformation & Stress
cards.back: Brittle deformation: rocks fracture under stress, producing joints, faults and fractures (dominant at shallow depths, low temperature, fast strain rate)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Rock Deformation & Stress
cards.back: Ductile deformation: rocks bend or flow under stress, producing folds and cleavage (dominant at depth, high temperature, slow strain rate)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Rock Deformation & Stress
cards.back: Normal faults form under tension: the hanging wall moves down relative to the footwall

cards.front: Recall a key point about Rock Deformation & Stress
cards.back: Reverse (thrust) faults form under compression: the hanging wall moves up relative to the footwall

cards.front: Recall a key point about Rock Deformation & Stress
cards.back: Strike-slip faults form under shear stress: blocks move horizontally past each other
